UVA PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
Appointments made by the Governor of the Uva Province

BY virtue of powers vested in me under Section 32(1) of the Provincial Council Act, No. 42 of 1987, I, M. P. Jayasinghe,Governor of Uva Province, do hereby announce that I have made the following appointments.

01. Mr. Gunadasa Samarasinghe, Class I officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, as Secretary to the Ministryof Agriculture, Irrigation, Animal Product, Inland Fisheries Affairs of Uva Province with immediate effect fromthe date 07.12.2015.

02. Mr. G. K. S. L. Rajadasa, Class I officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, as Secretary to the Ministry ofRoad Development, Housing, Water Supply, Estate Infrastructure and Co-operative Affairs of Uva Province,with immediate effect from the date 07.12.2015.

03. Mr. Sumith Suraweera, Class I officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, as Secretary to the Ministry ofSports and Youth Affairs, Tourism, Transport, Cultural Affairs and Textiles and Small Industries of Uva Province,with immediate effect from the date 07.12.2015.

04. Mr. W. M. M. G. Abeysinghe Banda, Class I officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, as Deputy ChiefSecretary (Personnel & Training) of Uva Province, with immediate effect from the date 07.12.2015.

05. Mr. R. M. T. B. Hathiyaldeniya, Class I officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, to act as Secretary to theCo-operative Service Commission of Uva Province in addition to his permanent post, with immediate effectfrom the date 03.12.2015.

06. Dr. H. G. G. L. P. Ariyadasa, to perform the Duties of the Regional Director to the Health Service of Monaragala,in addition to his permanent post, from the date 04.12.2015 to 07.12.2015, till the return of Dr. P. D. K.Adhikari, to the Island who is the Regional Director to the Health Service of Monaragala.
M. P. JAYASINGHE,Governor of Uva Province.
Office of the Uva Governor,07th December 2015.
